info.title: POS / POS Referral Onboarding API
info.description: Backend for the digital onboarding flow (link generation, form, documents, approvals) for POS, POS Referral, and BQP Employee. Login/auth is provided by an existing system and is not part of this service.

post.description:
Called by the SM (Sales Manager) app after the SM logs in and enters
the POS / Referral name + mobile number. Creates the onboarding
record and returns a token + shareable URL - nothing is rendered by
this backend; the URL points at a route the frontend team owns.

POS / POS Referral only - BQP Employees skip link generation
entirely, see POST /api/v1/employees/onboard.

get.description:
The frontend's onboarding page calls this on load (using the :token
from its own route) to validate the link and get the prefill data
(name, number, email, user_type, current status) needed to render
the correct form/step, pre-filled and non-editable. This is how the
shared link "renders" on the frontend - the backend never serves
HTML, it only backs the route.

post.description:
BQP Employee onboarding - no SM, no link generation. The employee
(or whoever raises it) submits name/number/email directly; user_type
is forced to EMPLOYEE and the record starts at FORM_IN_PROGRESS
(there's no LINK_GENERATED stage since no link exists). The
returned token drives the same onboarding/document endpoints as the
POS/Referral flow - PUT .../onboarding/{token}/form,
POST .../onboarding/{token}/documents, POST .../onboarding/{token}/submit.

Document data extraction (PAN/Aadhaar/bank details into
document_details) is done by a separate document-processing service
calling the existing PUT .../documents/{pan,aadhaar,bank}-details
endpoints - nothing extra needed here for that.

put.description:
Edits ONLY terms_and_conditions, independent of the general form-save
endpoint. terms_and_conditions is set to a fixed value at record
creation - this is the sole way to change it afterward.

post.description:
Final "Review & Submit" step, same for POS/Referral/Employee. Runs
basic form/document validation and a duplicate-number check, then
moves the record to SUBMITTED - OPS explicitly starts the
eligibility check from there (POST .../admin/onboarding/{id}/review
with next_status=UNDER_REVIEW).

schema.title: Response List Onboarding Api V1 Admin Onboarding Get

post.description:
Moves a record one step through the OPS pipeline:
SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW -> UNDER_TRAINING -> ONBOARDED -> AGREEMENT
-> WELCOME_MESSAGE, no skipping. REJECTED/SEND_BACK are only legal
while at UNDER_REVIEW (eligibility check).

Manually promotes an onboarded POS Referral to a full POS. Feeds the
Ageing Report: joining_date (set on first reaching ONBOARDED) and
pos_conversion_date (set here) together give the "how long were they
a referral" duration.

schema.title: Response List Users Data Api V1 Admin Users Data Get
Response List Document Details Api V1 Admin Document Details Get

get.description:
Date of Joining -> POS Referral -> POS Conversion Date.

Includes every record that either currently is a POS Referral
(pending conversion) or was converted from one (pos_conversion_date
is set) - a plain POS that was never a referral has neither and is
excluded.

schema.title: Response Ageing Report Api V1 Admin Reports Ageing Get

AgeingReportItem.title: AgeingReportItem
AgeingReportItem.description:
One row of the Ageing Report: how long a POS Referral has been (or
was) a referral before converting to a POS.

conversion_status:
  - "CONVERTED": already promoted to POS - ageing_days is final.
  - "PENDING": still an active POS Referral - ageing_days counts up
    to today, and within_90_days tells you if the 90-day target has
    already been missed.

DocumentType.title: DocumentType
DocumentType.description: Which users_data file column an uploaded file is stored against.

raised_by.title: Raised By
raised_by.description: Employee code of whoever is raising this request

EmployeeOnboardRequest.title: EmployeeOnboardRequest
EmployeeOnboardRequest.description:
BQP Employee onboarding has no link-generation step - the employee
(or whoever is raising it on their behalf) fills this directly.
user_type is always EMPLOYEE; there's nothing to choose here.

EmployeeOnboardResponse.title: EmployeeOnboardResponse
EmployeeOnboardResponse.description:
No onboarding_url here - there's no link to share. token is the same
handle used everywhere else (PUT .../onboarding/{token}/form,
POST .../onboarding/{token}/documents, etc.) - the employee's own
client just holds onto it directly instead of receiving it via URL.

LinkPrefillResponse.title: LinkPrefillResponse
LinkPrefillResponse.description:
What the frontend pre-fills, non-editable, when the POS/Referral
opens their link - name/number/email/user_type are locked in at
link-generation time; everything else is filled in by the user.

OnboardingFormUpdate.title: OnboardingFormUpdate
OnboardingFormUpdate.description:
Partial/upsert payload for the fields the user fills in themselves.
name/number/email/user_type are set at link-generation (or, for a
BQP Employee, at POST /api/v1/employees/onboard) and are NOT
editable here - pre-filled and locked per spec. terms_and_conditions
is also NOT editable here - fixed at creation, editable only via
PUT .../terms-and-conditions.

OnboardingStatus.title: OnboardingStatus
OnboardingStatus.description:
Pipeline (POS / POS Referral / BQP Employee all share it once a
record exists):

  LINK_GENERATED (POS/Referral only - set at link creation, an
  Employee record starts at FORM_IN_PROGRESS since there's no link)
    -> FORM_IN_PROGRESS (first form save)
    -> SUBMITTED (user submits)
    -> UNDER_REVIEW (OPS starts the eligibility check)
    -> UNDER_TRAINING
    -> ONBOARDED (joining_date is stamped here - see UsersData.joining_date)
    -> AGREEMENT
    -> WELCOME_MESSAGE

REJECTED / SEND_BACK are the only exits, and only from UNDER_REVIEW
(eligibility check failed). SEND_BACK rotates the token and unlocks
the form for corrections; REJECTED is terminal.

OPS drives every UNDER_REVIEW -> ... -> WELCOME_MESSAGE transition
explicitly via POST /api/v1/admin/onboarding/{id}/review - see
app.routers.workflow.PIPELINE_ORDER.

ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest
ReviewRequest.description:
next_status must be the immediate next stage in the pipeline
(see app.routers.workflow.PIPELINE_ORDER) - e.g. from UNDER_REVIEW
you may only move to UNDER_TRAINING, REJECTED, or SEND_BACK; no
skipping stages. REJECTED/SEND_BACK are only legal while the record
is at UNDER_REVIEW (the eligibility-check stage).

UsersDataWithDocumentDetails.title: UsersDataWithDocumentDetails
UsersDataWithDocumentDetails.description:
users_data + its document_details row, joined on users_data_id.
document_details is null if that record hasn't saved any PAN/Aadhaar/
bank details yet.
